title: Intelligent Document Processing
breadcrumb: Services > Agentic AI & Hyperautomation > Intelligent Document Processing
meta_description: Intelligent Document Processing from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: The honest pitch for intelligent document processing fits in a sentence — Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end — extraction, validation and downstream action. — and the rest of this page is the how: measured baseline, bounded build, evidence in flight.

Documents are where knowledge work goes to die: claims packets, trade documents, loan files, clinical referrals, supplier invoices. We build IDP pipelines that classify, extract and validate at document level — combining layout-aware OCR, vision-language extraction, and business-rule validation against upstream systems — then push clean structured data into the process that needs it, with confidence thresholds routing uncertain pages to humans.

Accuracy is delivered by the feedback loop: extraction QA sampling, correction capture that retrains the extractors, and genre-specific benchmarks (your contracts, not generic legal NER). Typical first-year scope covers 80-90% of document volume in a target process with straight-through rates that make the human team a review function rather than a typing pool.

Programs of Intelligent Document Processing run in Insurance & Risk, Banking & Financial Services, Logistics & Supply Chain, Healthcare & Life Sciences — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
What ships, in the order it ships:

items: Ingestion & classification
multi-channel intake (email, portal, scan, API) with genre routing
Layout-aware extraction
OCR + vision-language models tuned to your document genres
Validation layer
business rules, system lookups and cross-field consistency checks
Confidence routing
threshold-based human review with correction capture
Downstream action
clean structured events into core systems, RPA or agent workflows
